description:
Our Rotary Ann, Dr. Leeladevi Mudunuri, left everyone spellbound with her incredibly intelligent, creative and engaging games! She kept the members and their families thoroughly entertained, challenging their minds while filling the atmosphere with laughter, excitement and fun.
A brilliant blend of intelligence, creativity and entertainment! Kudos to Dr. Leeladevi for making the gathering so memorable!
